Definition: from a form of G3485 and κορέω (to sweep); a temple-servant, i.e. (by implication) a votary:--worshipper.
BiblicalUsage: The town clerk of Ephesus boasts that the city is the temple-keeper of the great goddess Diana, and he quiets the riot with the claim.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the clerk's boast is the confession of idolatry: the whole city keeps Diana's temple, and the man who quiets the riot does it by praising the goddess.
